the-bundle-is-the-leaf-then-its-issuer: ssl_base.pp:79-81 name the bundle ${ssl_certs_dir}/${myprefix}.${myservice}.bundle.crt = /etc/ssl/certs/p8test.nginx.bundle.crt from p8test.crt then p8test.intermediate.crt, and 100-119 make it a concat 0644 owner/group root (defaults) with fragment 01 the first cert and 02 the intermediate; the probe expects root:root 644, 2 certificates, CN p8test.invalid then p8test throwaway CA (the fixture's intermediate stand-in), and the first verifying against the second. Mismatch swaps only the trust anchor to the system CA bundle, which did not sign the leaf, so verify must fail; it did
